comment: Train/eval separation. heldout: per-scanner report stems kept out of training and evaluated with scanner-export baselines. denied_stems: never train (same-scanner app duplicate of a held-out; eval-only scanners without machine gold; legacy hand-made baselines). eval_only_hosts: hosts of the held-out app targets, denied across ALL scanners so those apps stay eval-only everywhere. Cross-scanner overlap on other hosts is allowed by design (matched hosts carry largely distinct finding sets; embedded-model plan s11).
